questions.q: Which Azure storage product is the real-world example of file storage?
options: Managed Disks
Azure Table storage
Blob storage
Azure Files
questions.explain: Azure Files provides an SMB/NFS mountable share, the same file-storage concept taught generically in the prior course.

questions.q: What makes Azure Files different from a Managed Disk?
options: Azure Files is always more expensive than a Managed Disk
There is no meaningful difference between the two
Multiple VMs can mount the same Azure Files share at once, while a Managed Disk normally attaches to only one VM
A Managed Disk can be mounted by unlimited VMs simultaneously
questions.explain: Azure Files is a shared filesystem multiple machines can mount concurrently, which is exactly the problem block storage like Managed Disks doesn't solve.

questions.q: Which Azure product is the real-world example of block storage?
options: Azure Queue storage
Azure Files
Managed Disks
Blob storage
questions.explain: Managed Disks present raw, fixed-size block storage attached to one VM, exactly like a physical hard drive — Azure's block storage product.

questions.q: A team of three app servers all need to read and write the same uploaded-images folder simultaneously. Which storage type fits best?
options: Blob storage, because objects can be mounted like a drive
None of these support simultaneous multi-VM access
Azure Files, because it's a shared filesystem multiple VMs can mount at once
A Managed Disk, because disks are the fastest option
questions.explain: This is the classic file-storage use case: a shared filesystem several machines need to mount concurrently, which Azure Files is built for.

questions.q: What does the --quota flag set on az storage share create?
options: The maximum size, in GiB, provisioned for the file share
The number of VMs allowed to mount the share
The number of days before the share auto-deletes
The performance tier of the storage account
questions.explain: --quota sets the maximum provisioned size of the Azure file share in GiB.
